fresh_campaign_binding.note: Evidence binding only; future CURRENT must be Fresh Read again.

new_stage.contribution: A single fixed PRE-only line-mean score proxy at coefficient 0.16 worsened C1 in all four fixed W1 blocks and recovered none of the oracle improvement under the prespecified metric.

updated_integrated_mechanism_conclusion.label: HIDDEN_SHARED_STATE_VALUE_ESTABLISHED_IN_SIMULATOR_BUT_NAIVE_PRE_LINE_MEAN_SCORE_PROXY_FAILS
updated_integrated_mechanism_conclusion.statement: The current Synthetic evidence strongly supports that the canonical W1 hidden shared line state is valuable and explains the prior N1 advantage when omitted from C1. However, simply averaging already-observed rider scores within line and adding that aggregate to C1 does not estimate the useful hidden component; it worsens predictions. Therefore hidden-state existence/value and recoverability from a naive observable aggregate must remain separate scientific claims.
updated_integrated_mechanism_conclusion.relationship_to_prior_label: The prior OMITTED_SHARED_LATENT_STATE_PROXY_PLUS_EXPLICIT_CONDITIONAL_RELATION_AMPLIFICATION mechanism remains supported as an explanation of simulator behavior. The new result narrows the recovery claim: naive PRE line-mean score is not an adequate estimator of that hidden shared state.

what_is_now_falsified_or_weakened_within.claim: The useful hidden W1 shared state can be adequately recovered by the exact simple PRE line-mean score proxy with coefficient 0.16.
what_is_now_falsified_or_weakened_within.basis: Proxy worsened C1 in all four blocks and aggregate recovery fraction was 0.0.

what_is_now_falsified_or_weakened_within.claim: The oracle result alone implies an obvious deployable PRE feature.
what_is_now_falsified_or_weakened_within.basis: The first prespecified lawful PRE aggregate tested failed strongly despite the oracle hidden-state value.

still_open: Whether any other lawful PRE-observable estimator can recover analogous shared-state information without leakage.
Whether the failure is driven by double-counting individual score information, measurement noise, estimator bias, or another synthetic mechanism.
Whether any analogous shared state exists in real keirin.
Whether any architecture or feature has real-world predictive or economic value.
